title: Offer Papyrus newsrooms as one sellable product family
description:
Feature: A Papyrus newsroom is sellable even though each site is its own product
  Scenario: An operator sells a newsroom on a site
    Given per-site products papyrus-<site> in accounts/papyrus-sites.json
    When an operator or the portal lists what can be sold
    Then each editor site appears under the family papyrus with a display name, and public-reader sites never appear
    And granting a newsroom is an entitlement to that site's product (kanbus-592fbb)

Change: add display and family metadata to papyrus-sites.json entries (reviewed, unknown fields still refused) and expose it to the operator directory and Anthus One portal. Plan IDs and prices belong to the billing plan catalog in kanbus-a78bcd, not here.
